title: Unattended merge on green CI
summary: Squash-merges every pull request whose CI (and review, if any) is green, pinned to the validated commit; docs-only ones merge at once. Never unattended: Claude instruction files, a CI Claude session's branch, a Dependabot bump the gate holds, and existing tests that lose lines once the project names its tests.

CI_WORKFLOW.prompt: Name of the CI workflow that must be green before a merge (its `name:`)

postInstall: Before installing, check that GitHub enforces rulesets on this repository (on some plans a private repository only gets a warning on its Rulesets page): without one, do not use this module. Then protect the default branch with a ruleset: no direct push, a code-owner review required for .github/workflows/**, no bypass for GitHub Actions. A pull request runs its own copy of the workflows, so one that rewrites auto-merge.yml is judged by its own version: docs/conventions/auto-merge-policy.md § Setting it up.

The workflow auto-merge waits for (the name given at install, "CI" by default) must exist under that exact `name:`, run on pull_request, and skip docs/**, **.md, LICENSE and .gitignore on push and pull_request (it may re-include Claude instruction files, which are never merged unattended) — otherwise a docs-only pull request merges while its CI is still running.

Fill the four TODO(harness) comments in .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml: the paths of your own that are executed (PROJECT_GATE_RE, with a row each in scripts/auto-merge-paths.txt — CLAUDE_GATE_RE is the kit's list, leave it), the paths of your tests (TEST_HOLD_RE, with `test` rows in the same file: until it is filled, a pull request that deletes a failing test merges on green), where a Dependabot major may go through (MAJOR_HOLD_RE, every major is held as shipped), and whether something must be dispatched after a merge.

A merge made by this workflow emits no push event: anything that deploys or tests on push to the default branch will not run after it. docs/conventions/auto-merge-policy.md § After the merge says how to add a dispatch.
